title: Scope
description: pcs.v2 restricted retrieval scope (J.2): project_id, session_id, scene, entity_ids, goal_id. All fields are optional; an empty object means namespace-general. This is not goal_scope and grants no file or network permission. Unknown keys are rejected and reported as SCOPE_VIOLATION by the contract checker.

entity_ids.description: Entity identifiers within the scope. Duplicates are structural noise and rejected.
